request.style: English, children's choir, energetic children's voices shouting and singing, drums, electric guitar and bright piano, a joyful march, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The blind and the lame came to him in the temple
And he healed them there
The chief priests saw the wonderful things
And the children crying out

[Chorus]
Hosanna, hosanna
Hosanna to the Son of David
Hosanna, hosanna
Hosanna to the Son of David

[Verse]
Do you hear what these are saying
Yes, have you never read
Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies
You have prepared praise

[Chorus]
Hosanna, hosanna
Hosanna to the Son of David
Hosanna, hosanna
Hosanna to the Son of David
